actions.action: Free instant transfers to other banks
Debit card cash back for 4 weeks

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 2 weeks. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 1%, up to $5 cash back. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 10 (students).
Actions: Free instant transfers to other banks, Debit card cash back for 4 weeks, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $2,000,000 of the $4M budget.

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks
Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers
Zero-interest advance up to $500, up to 20,000 customers

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.25 points, on balances up to $50,000. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit.
